about.heading: A little bit about me
about.intro: I'm Nepes Sopyyev, a passionate Full Stack Developer from Turkmenistan. I enjoy building web and mobile applications, learning new technologies and solving real-world problems with code.
about.second: My journey started with curiosity, and now it has grown into a strong passion for development. I'm always open to new opportunities, collaborations and interesting projects.

about.journeyDescription: From the first lines of HTML to building AI-powered products.

journey.step01Desc: Started with the fundamentals — how the web works, HTML, CSS and programming basics.
journey.step02Desc: Moved into component-driven interfaces with Vue, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
journey.step03Desc: Learned APIs, databases and server-side logic with Node.js and Express.
journey.step04Desc: Built complete products end to end — from database schema to polished interface.
journey.step05Desc: Added retrieval-augmented AI and computer vision to real products like Melhem AI.
journey.step06Desc: Keep shipping meaningful products and contribute to open source.
